memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Intermittent spinning sensation on turning head right, lasts <1 minute, Dix-Hallpike pending.
  - Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg BD after food, meclizine 25 mg SOS after food; arrange Dix-Hallpike and audiometry.
- Depression
  - Status: Low mood, anhedonia, PHQ-9 12, sleep disturbance.
  - Plan: Start sertraline 50 mg OD after food; review PHQ-9 in 4 weeks.
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: Nasal congestion, sneezing, worse mornings.
  - Plan: Cetirizine 10 mg HS after food, fluticasone nasal spray one spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS after food.
- Weight 58 kg, waist 78 cm (female cutoff 80 cm) – within limit.
- Diet advice: Breakfast – idli with sambar, avoid fried; Lunch – rice, dal, vegetables, limit salt; Dinner – chapati, dal, salad, early.
- Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Episodes reduced to once weekly, mild, after betahistine increase.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 24 mg BD after food, stop meclizine; teach Epley maneuver self‑practice.
- Depression
  - Status: Mood improved, PHQ-9 6, mild insomnia.
  - Plan: Increase sertraline to 75 mg OD after food; add mirtazapine 15 mg HS for sleep.
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: Symptoms controlled, occasional sneezing.
  - Plan: Continue cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone OD, montelukast HS.
- Weight 59 kg, waist 80 cm (at cutoff).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – poha with peanuts, avoid sugary tea; Lunch – mixed veg rice, dal, curd; Dinner – roti, dal, steamed veg, early.
- Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to ENT specialist for persistent positional vertigo despite medical therapy, to confirm BPPV side and consider canalith repositioning.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: ENT report: Confirmed right posterior canal BPPV. Performed Epley maneuver in clinic, patient asymptomatic post‑procedure. Advised home Epley twice daily for 1 week. No further intervention needed.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I felt brief dizziness yesterday when looking up, but it settled quickly. No nausea. My nose is still clear, mood good.

- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: No vertigo episodes in past 8 weeks, Epley exercises continued.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; stop if symptom‑free for another month.
- Depression

- Allergic rhinitis

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Symptom‑free for 6 months, off betahistine for 2 months.
  - Plan: No medication needed; advise vestibular exercises if symptoms recur.
- Depression
  - Status: PHQ-9 2, remission, on sertraline 50 mg OD after taper.
  - Plan: Continue sertraline 50 mg OD; review in 3 months.
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: Well controlled on cetirizine HS and fluticasone OD.
  - Plan: Continue current regimen.
- Weight 59 kg, waist 79 cm (within limit).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – dosa with chutney, avoid sugary sides; Lunch – brown rice, sambar, veg; Dinner – roti, dal, salad, early.
